long_biography.plain_text:
Mirwais Azizi’s early plans for apartment buildings in Dubai’s Al Furjan district were interrupted by the global financial crisis. He refunded buyers who could no longer pay and returned to the market in 2013, redesigning the original towers and buying more land. The revived programme extended beyond Al Furjan to Palm Jumeirah.

In Afghanistan, Azizi used his resources to rebuild Sia Ab after an earthquake destroyed the village. The replacement settlement included houses, a school, a clinic, a playground and a water well. Residents came to call it Azizi Town, and he travelled from Dubai to open it.
